name: Shariah Compliance and Data Lineage Audit
description: Validates that all screened holdings adhere strictly to Shariah guidelines, document hashes exist, and data quality checks return PASS.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Data Quality & Lineage tab
Assert that Overall Integrity Status badge displays PASS or WARNING and zero FAIL status
Assert that the detailed verification table contains checks for fund_metadata, duplicate_transactions, numeric_fields, unit_balance, and document_hashes
Assert that the Mermaid data lineage graph is rendered showing unidirectional flow from official sources to DuckDB to calculations
